Hah! A very interesting question indeed, good sir. I find it very fascinating, and I must admit that the thought has never crossed my mind. 

In the Age of Legends, honour and public adoration could only be achieved through service, which could take place in many fields. We have only got to know Cadsuane as an extremely adaptable, skilled survivalist who charges head-on and takes command. Also, her specialty has been the gentling of channelling men '''and''' ''keeping them alive''. I find it hard to "translate" her current specialty to something that was done in the Age of Legends. If there had been no channelling men, what would she have done? If there were no Shadowspawn, there would be no Green Ajah, and Cadsuane is pretty much the modern archetype of a Green sister. What would she have done if there were no ''saidin''-wielding men and no Trollocs to rid the world of? We can only guess. I for one don't belive she would have achieved such great recognition, based on what we know about her. But for all we know, she might have been an extraordinary woman even in the Age of Legends. Her most foremost trait is her adaptability and her surviving skills - surely she could have done something with that. But again, we can only guess.
